Ana (All-Hands): Thanks for the great questions in the reliability segment. Using this thread to capture follow-ups, owners, and links. Keep replies short.

Tess (CTO): RCA is published: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0911
Top-level root cause: routing state drift combined with an autoscaler reg that reduced effective headroom under load. Fallback didn’t trigger for a subset of requests.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): Mitigations we ran: rolled back the reg, temporarily increased per-region headroom, and forced stable variant routing for affected customers. I’ll own a CI gate for router changes.

Jordan (SRE): Please add an oncall checklist snippet to the runbook. Quick draft below for review:
``
Symptoms: P95 latency + error spike in single region; fallback not engaging
Checks: router state (git diff), KV cache misses, autoscale headroom, model-variant mapping health
Quick mitigation: revert router change, force-route to stable variant, scale headroom, notify infra
Post: link logs + open RCA
```

Priya (Infra): I'll add an autoscale metric: min-available-headroom and an alarm if headroom < X for 2m. Owning warm buffer rollout for critical regions. ETA: 12 days for rollout and alarms.

Sara (Product): Dedicated customers were isolated; please include that in the customer note so AEs can reassure contacts.

Ana (All-Hands): Drafting the customer note now. Will post in #customer-comms in ~3 hours. Lina from CS will help finalize wording.

Tess (CTO): Action items from all-hands (owners + short ETAs):
- Router-diff CI block (prevent divergent routing diffs) owner: Ravi ETA: 7 days
- Autoscale headroom metrics + alarms owner: Priya ETA: 12 days
- Canary e2e test for model-variant compatibility on deploys owner: Jordan/ML Infra ETA: 14 days
- Runbook snippet + 30-min tabletop for oncall teams owner: Jordan ETA: 5 days
- Customer communications draft + AE outreach owner: Ana + CS ETA: 48h

Ravi (Eng-SRE): PR opened for router CI gate: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/4750
I'll link tests once CI passes.

Jordan (SRE): Integration issue for model-variant canary: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-infra/issues/812
Planning a small canary that runs compatibility checks on a shadowed request stream.

Priya (Infra): Ticket for warm buffer plan & alarm thresholds: https://trello.internal/redwood/c/159-warm-buffer-plan
Includes rollout schedule and burn-in requirements.

Tess (CTO): Leadership request: paste PR/issue URLs here as they are created so we can track closure in the follow-up doc. We'll review progress in the next reliability sync.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0911 marked RESOLVED. RCA link: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0911

Ana (All-Hands): I'll collate these into the post-all-hands follow-up doc and ping owners for status updates. If folks have additional quick asks from the Q&A, drop them here. :thumbsup:
